n: Gave the ball away bad pass
Good to be in defensive support, Good idea on the pass, poor quality of execution in dangerous area of the pitch.
Does well to intercept the ball, not under pressure has space to dribble into forces pass to Sophie too soon.
Giselle see's the pass played backwards, pushes to press and forces the keeper into a rushed pass that wins us the ball back
Clearance, ball bouncing around in and around our box, Kendall clears out of bounds.
Team effort to keep the loose ball out of the box.

Build Out, opponent flexed off, player on the ball brings the ball out, drives into half space and plays a ball into the central channel where even if our CM receives it's a 4 v 1, when the entire wide channel she started in was wide open for her to dribble into and draw pressure.

Sonia correctly plays short to Carlee who has 15 yards of space and no immediate pressure, the opponent is in a block. Carlee tries to play a long pass into our 7 in the wide channel, it gets intercepted.
After a foul, Alexa plays short to Mack, who has all the space in the left channel to dribble into and doesn't even look over there, dribbles centrally and plays a ball that gets turned over.

Sophie in good position at the 9, shifts when the ball is played back, then again when the ball is played negative she recognizes the pressing trigger on the poor first touch and accelerates forcing a challenge and 50/50 ball the Sola competes very aggressively for. The ball continues to be contested and Kendall joins and competes on the ball and wins a foul. All out effort by all three players. These are winning moments.

Sophie wins a 50/50 ball played in off the foul, turns and sees a window to drive into the penalty box, gets fouled, ref doesn't call. I like Sola, Kendall and Scarletts positioning here as well. Ultimately could Sophie pass here yes, but it's clear what her idea was and it was brave positive attempt.
1st time pass, I think she's trying to play Sophie, but settle the ball, combine with your two midfielders are drive the ball towards the box.

Ari gets lucky with a threaded diagonal ball through three players to Sola, turns to get up field tries to play Sophie but turns it over. This is a good example of cutting back or turning back inside to combine with the midfielders rather than forcing it up the field.

Carlee bringing the ball out under no pressure, carries it up field and from what I can tell is laser focused on a target down the field and plays the ball into the most crowded spot of the field into a 5 v 2. The whole left side is open.
Almost carbon copy of prior play, Carlee receives, head goes down as she's dribbling up and plays the ball into the most crowded area.
I appreciate the 4 players that were tracking back to keep the numbers in our favor to secure this long ball in the wind. We had one player #4 who didn't track back with the group.

Throw in from Mack, good set by Sola back to Mack, then time stood still, mid fielders didn't do a great job of providing support, that said they wouldn't have been a great option, the team needs to understand why we have to move the ball, which is to move the opponent, Alexa is a good support position as well as Carlee and Ari, this ball needed to go back to Alexa to switch the point of attack. Instead we forced a ball into pressure and lost it. The pass with played with her right foot, it should'be been with her left for the pass she was trying to make.
At least we didn't force it, but our technical quality was lacking and if part of the reason this broke down,

then our movement or wrong movements I should say. Scarlet and Kendall need help understanding their responsbilities, when kendall checks in low to the pivot, Scarlet comes from her postion all the way across to the central zone Kendall vacated, but the defenders followed Kendall so now Scarlet isn't playable and Kendall has no choice but to play back to Alexa. If Scarlet had stayed home Kendal could've turned and played Scarlet. The movement is also creating Scarlet to move more than she needs to.
I understand why she took the space, but feel the pressure turn out and play negative, or make the decision to play Sophie over the top sooner.
Midfielders are on top of eachother moving in sync in the same vertical channel. They need to understand they can't occuyp the same vertical channel, only exception is defending.
Giselle is making a obvious effort to defend, communicate defensive movement to her winger to go and press and displays good hustle that forces a bad pass.
It was a quick transition, but Sola tries to play on the dribble and loses it.

I understand the desire to get forward and play Sophie, but we need to recognize the moment. even if Sophie gets on the end of this, it's 3 v 1. Sola is running free even with the ball in the wide channel. We have to advance the ball in possession to create quality chances. If this ball is played wide, it will pull the defense out of their compact shape, then Sola can either cross back in, cutback and play G or Sophie in the box.

Ball come in on a throw in, bounces around bit finally collected by Kendall who doesn't force it, plays back to Mack. Mack tries a one time pass into Scarlett in the central channel 3 v 1. Very dangerous ball that starts a quick counter.

Mack turns the ball over then starts tracking back. As she doing so she starts opening wide which open a big channel for her mark to run through straight to goal, a better team hits that split, we get lucky and the ball is played out the other way.
Mack literally stands and watches Alexa bring the ball out, it turns over and she barely moves.

Build Out, no pressure and Alexa forces the pass, our center backs need to realize just cause they're not getting pressured doesn't mean they need to play the ball, either a invite the pressure by carrying the ball up the field, or play laterally to for the defense to shift out of their position to open the passing lanes.
received the ball with no idea, had nothing but defenders in front and tried to dribble through. Really though all she had was a quick pass centrally to our 10 or turning out and playing negative.

4 pasing string not quite 5. Carlee finally looked to her left and found Kendall, it wasn't a good pass though but it was the right one. I would've like to seen us move the out the other direction but we played into the pressure and managed to get two more passes up the field before the turnover.
Alexa, stay central on this counter. You lose the runner and you start drifting wide. Stay home and central.

We build out but this is a good example of why technical ability matters so much. The ball is bouncing around all of the place, poor set passes, lead to loss of time and space and a lot of wasted physical energy and mental energy.

Good example of we don't understand our spacing. The defense is set up in a back 5. The rest of the defense is  compact in the central channel. Mack is on the ball and plays a ball centrally into the exact spot they want us to play. Our 9 or 10 is providing zero depth. Sophie drops low to receive, Brookly is in no mans land. If she see's Sophie drop, she needs to create depth and get between the centerbacks. Our 11 Sola is wide, but she's too far up the field, so again not playable. Mack is too casual on the ball. Sophie sets back to Mack, but never once looks over her shoulder to find a her help in the side channel. Everyone is fixated on the ball, I need them to be fixated on finding space.
I can hear Sophie calling out instruction to Sola to watch the wide player. I really appreciate that.

Sad- build out. People are walking, it's hard to watch. Either cause they don't understand which at this level that's hard to fathom as every player has 1 or more years at comp, I've seen rec play with more movement or game understanding. It's either they're too cool, or they don't care enough, or they generally think they're doing nothing wrong.
Quickly moved into team defensive shape. This was good, we wanted them to go wide and that's what they did, 50/50 ball goes out bounds.

Sonia plays cami as the defense walking away (good), Cami takes space and invites the pressure plays Ari, then ari does well to cut in centrally to find her midfield, Kendall then plays the ball back to Ari whos running towards her goal but has a sea of space the other direction.
Once Kendall played it back, Ari who did well to cut in and find her midfield 20 seconds ago, this time sends the ball down field into a contested 50/50 ball that we lose. When the switch was on.

Evelyn does well to received, turn to get forward, finds a diagonal lane to her 7, plays a decent ball but Gracie is late, walking as the ball is played instead of being ready to move into the space to receive.
Sola on - Grace off, Scarlett on - Kendall off, Giselle on - Sophie Off
Switche the field, then Ari tries to play a long ball into our 11 but it's not hit well and goes out of bounds. We're playing to fast in this example.
Brooklyn is in rest defense, receives the ball on her weakside of the field but plays right back into all the traffic.
Ari gets the ball played out to her from the central channel, she goes to play the ball back in centrally and plays a bad ball that gets turned over.
Good rest defense by Brooklyn, she's tucked in and behind the ball, when the switch finds her mark she's there to challenge and stop the forward attack.

We do a good a job swining the ball and resetting the point of attack. The ball goes into Scarlet late centrally and because of the late ball she arrives just before the defender and carries the ball with her momentum then plays into pressure and turns it over.
Ari plays a very dangerous ball into the central channel that is well covered would've resulted on a shot on a goal had the half not ended.

Attacking transition, Giselle wins the ball in our attacking half quickly gets forward in the central channel, Sola does a good job running in the wide space and Giselle plays a diagonal ball that leads to a shot off target.
Excellent hustle and pressing action by Giselle, she starts the press, continues it and forces a turnover.
Scarlett displays good hustle tracking back centrally and attacking the ball, does a solid shoulder to shoulder challenge and forces a turnover in our favor.

Kendall probably could've pulled the back and reset the play, but I appreciate the effort and tenacity to get forward here. The question for Kendall is when should this type of effort be made? It's the start of the second half, I like the effort here as it's setting a tone.

Ball comes in on a throw in Evelyn receives but takes a heavy touch which goes right back to Ari who threw it in. But Ari then sends the ball in the air into the central channel, we have one player in the vicinity. Leads to a turnover.

Kendall over dribbles, after three consecutive passes to get the ball forward into the attacking 3rd, she's our 7 in this moment and she is the widest player but is in the central channel. She ends up dribbling into a 3 v 1 and turns it over. She had one moment to take the initial on ball defender on and maybe she gets into the box, but too much side to side and the defense recovers but she forces the issue.

Kendall overcommits a bit on her positioning getting to high up the pitch, ball played wide and she has to quickly recover, which she does and then goes challenge with a strong tackle that I believe was clean but gets called for a foul.

Free kick by the opponent from the middle 3rd going into our defending 3rd. Our center backs identify the 9, but Mack (left back) is pointing to Alexa to pick up the second nine the opponent lines up with, but this should be her mark and when the ball is kicked this player has a free run in behind. Then on the ball side our outside back Ari starts in a good position but ball watches and loses her mark her runs right by her and up into the box and Ari doesn't even follow. We got lucky as the ball is cleared out of bounds.
Goal Scored off of a Corner Kick. Nice ball in by Giselle (2), Ella (25), Brooklyn (37) crash the box, crowd the goalie and the ball appears to go off of both of them. Then bounces into the goal.
Set Piece, ball served into the box, but we don't have any numbers running into the box to challenge for the ball.
Scralett on the ball dribbling at goal inot pressure, could've turned and play her 6 or even forward to her 10.

Foul - Direct Free Kick - We have to realize that Giselle has excellent service into the box. I need to work on set piece work with the team. We we're spread out everywhere in the box, ball served in, off the goalies hands and we were there to put home a easy goal.
Right at 5 passes, played our 1, then to our 5, 6, 2, 7 and worked the ball quickly up the field.
Scarlet wins the ball, tries to play down the line to Kendall where she would be in a 3 v 1 if she wins, plays the ball too hard goes out the back for a goal kick.
Build Out, no immediate pressure and we have time on the ball. Ball is played vertical  right into the defense. There is space on the whole right side of the field.
turned into pressure
carlee forces another ball into a tight space centrally, Scarlett doesn't check her shoulder and is met with immediate pressure
Sophie gets forward immediately, but player in behind pokes the ball away, giselle takes off to early up the field and isn't playable.
Drop Kick by Sonia, wind at our back and a great opportunity for our 9/10 but sophie and giselle miss the opportunity and the ball sails over their heads.
We completely lost our mark and gave up a goal that tied the game on the last action of the game. Grace ran away from her mark who got a head on the ball.
First opportunity to build out in the game from a saved corner kick, played short wide, found our way back inside, then got vertical, then out wide to the left wing.

Turned and faced for the 1 v 1 and lost the ball, when she turned and faced the opponent was on her so fast she couldn't set her feet and take her on properly. She has to take a quick look when driving into the box.

Giselle does well too drop early on support defense when the opponent is trying to setup their attack in our defending 3rd. Sophie reads a pass that comes in and intercepts, Giselle quickly gets forward. But Sophie plays a poor ball. But overall decent defensive movememtn.

Ball travels wide in our defending 3rd. 1 v1 Kendall vs the attacker, Kendall stabs at it, gets beat, the attacker goes by then puts in a cross into the box. Cross goes over Sonias hands, partially disrupted by her own Center Back Carlee. The only defenders in a good position was Alexa near post in to pick up the attacker Kendall had. Carlee comes completely out of her position overly aggressive and forgets about the 9/10 of the opponent (who scored), Ari doesn't even bother coming for her full back spot to defend. Scarlet is watching as a CM. Mack is out in the 11 just standing, marking nobody, watching not helping. Just poor defensive awareness early in the game.
Ari, just sends it up field with no idea, for no reason
Kendall 1 v 1 defending, jockeying, waits for the moment then clears the ball away on a heavy tough, good work
Under pressure, Carlee played back to our keeper, Sonia was calm on the ball, Alexa was calm, as well as Kendall, who ended up getting fouled.

The opponent CM is driving the ball in the half space, our CM is tracking them side by side, Ari leaves her mark (the winger) to step and challenge the ball carrier. She gets beat and the ball carrier passes the ball to the winger left behind, advances the ball and wins a corner. Ari should have kept flexing off because the player on the ball was already marked.

Kendall receives from the center back, takes space but holds the ball too long, loses it in a tough challenge. Should've played centrally early to her CM or cut in.  Our winber could've stayed wide and showed as well.
another forced ball up the wide channel, trying to play our winger but it really wasn't on.
Wins the ball centrally, drives and plays a nice early ball wide to her 9 who moves into that channel

receives and quickly loses the ball in a 1 v 1. She really had two options on this, take a big touch into space and use her strenght and quickness to get to the goal line or but back and face her up. Instead she take the touch on the dribble but never gets square with the defender.
Evelyn checks into the pivot, but sets the ball back, should've turned but she  didn't check for space.
Another ball where a teammate sets the ball to Ari and her first touch is too blast it long.
Carlee Flexes off, nice challenge for the ball, wins a goal kick.
Cami receives from goal kick, tries to carry the ball up the field. but should'be played back Alexa as the defense overcommits to her.
EVelyn stays on the dribble too long, loses it.
Brooklyn wins the ball, but then give it back on a poor pass decision.
Kickoff, we work the ball back and side to side then lose it on first pass forward.
Sophie comes all the way down from her RW spot to defend and support Ari. Does well to stop the attack.
Nice clearance by Kendall on the 2nd corner kick, it's out and away downfield.
Tries to go 1 v 1 centrally, but gets denied. Best chance wouldve been to take the touch wide were the whole wide space was open.
Solid save by Sonia.
Own goal, Mackenzie went up to challenge the ball and body orientation caused the ball to go in to goal instead of away from goal.
Sola poor first touch pass
Grace wins the ball, gets forward but our attacking unit is slow to respond, Grace stays on the ball long enough to win a foul, but to get numbers forward it required coaching from th e sideline.
Carlee does a great job flexing off, staying in her channel and when the ball is served in she's able to clear it away. This is a very positive action for Carlee and one that should go in her IDP.
corner kick, Mack tries to clear the ball, it doesn't get in the air and the ball is basically passed right to an attacker in the box who puts it in the back of the net.
Ari, just keeps sending the ball long. Sends it into a 4 v 1 that even if Grace wins the ball she's stuck.

From our own Goal Kick, the ball is played into Carlee at the CB position, Evelyn checks in centrally at the top of the box she is open, Carlee plays her but misses the target by three yards, it goes to the opponent easy finish into the goal.
Long pass in by the opponent, Sonia comes out of her box in a good position and clears the ball up field with a really nice long clearance.

Opponent midfielder wins the ball centrally, immediately they recognize their winger is making a run. Our Full Back Mackenzie has no idea where this winger is, caught ball watching and the winger gets in behind on the ball. Then for some odd reason Mackenzie actually pulls out wide from the play when she should be going to the play for support.
Good build out, advanced out of def 3rd and into the middle 3rd, then turned the ball over on the pass into the final 3rd.
Forced a ball into the final 3rd. Just played the ball too soon as the defender was approaching, either pull back and go the other way or get forward on the dribble to beat the closing defender.

Very well played by all in involved. Ari RB is first to the ball that was punted by the keeper. Scarlett CM sets the pass back to Ella CM, Ella doesn't force anything and turns the ball and plays wide to Ari, Ari does a good job of keeping the ball on the deck and playing a line breaking pass from the middle 3rd straight into the attacking 3rd to Sophie. Sophie receives and plays a ball forward to Scarlett who carried her run forward and takes a shot on goal.

Mackenzie challenges for a tackle and loses at the mid field. That same player she challenged then passed the ball upfield and continued her run. Then Mack follows but never bothers to get in front or inside of the player who ends up being on the receiving end of a cross and scores a goal. That was really poor effort, recognition and defending.
Wins 50/50 ball, takes space, plays a good cross into the box.
Ball is played  to the attacker she is marking, she intercepts the ball but then sends a ball right back to the other team.
Sola tries to play a ball in the wide channel a little too early

Just a simple a pass into the wide channel, but the movement by Ella to get open and her first look on where to distribute the ball is excellent. Even when she plays the ball she balls back into her position in front of the centerbacks.
Giselle takes a heavy touch into the central channel that is congested with defenders and loses the ball. Wide space was wide open.
I understand why she made the pass, as turnover go I appreciate the attempt here but we need to see the field and recognize when we're not ready for that last line breaking pass.
The correct decision was to play the wide channel, not a 2 v1 and impossible ball to control
through ball, not a bad effort, timing was a bit off between the two, but good idea.
Brave attacking play, received the ball at the top of the box and split both centerbacks, clean left footed finish to the bottom right corner of the goal
Impressive on the ball attacking play
Great ball movement started in D3 outs side insidr straight up the field
Good challenge and hustle to win the ball abd earn a foul
Tries to play a through ball into the attacking third, difficult ball to play, best to hold up play
Kendall sets back to Cami but doesnt move into a supporting angle, then cami forces the ball into the defender
Hit a long ball to the wide channel so hard even if in target would’ve been hard to control
Good ball movement, worked the ball patiently through the thirds
Forced through ball, too early.
Good timed early run by sophie and good pass by Scarlett, just really good goal keeping by the opponent
Scarlett does great in space to get forward and finds G with a nice line breaking pass that drives the team into the final 3rd
G ends up attracting 3 defenders, but forces a half cross or shot, rather then pulling back and playing centrally
A free kick is sent in Sophie direction into a spot if she lets the ball go over shes running in behind the line, she takes the ball out of the air and towards our goal though.
Alexa overpowered, Kendall very poor positioning and help defense, cami not in great cover position, Sonia should’ve been able to cover this near post shot
Good effort by Sola to win a corner, Sophie nearly heads the corner in good effort
Reads play well and intercepts the ball
Cami effort and defensive shape good
Good sequence that started with defensive effort, then through the midfield finishing with our striker. This was a TEAM goal.
Dangerous turnover in our defending third by Mack, forced the pass trying to break the first line
Goff effort to push the ball in space but after that effort we want a better more quality look

Sonia comes way off her line to receive the back pass from Mack, didn’t need to come out that much and then slow on the bland nearly gets it taken away, then forces a pass and the other team nearly scored
Amy really good decision making and off the ball movement to receive again and start the attack
Mack forces an early pass into the 10, the best passing option available would’ve been a through ball for the seven to run onto.

The balls played back to our center back. Alexa Alexa, then plays Evelyn and the six. Evelyn has time in space to turn but doesn’t and sense. The bulb to Mac then Evelyn calls for a back, but she is not on a supporting angle. The ball is intercepted by the opponent 11 with then takes a long shot at goal. Sonia our keeper. It’s unclear what happened. I think she goes to ground. She doesn’t need to. She gets her hands on the ball and then fumbles the ball onto the goal.
Poor first touch, loses time and space then turns into pressure
Carlee gives up field position with unnecessary foul
how much does your job winning her first stool but then she quickly forces the Paul from the middle third trying to play a through ball. That never had a chance.
Brooklyn sets the ball to Evelyn but she stopped moving into space
For defensive challenge, or defensive challenge. Leads to shot on goal.
5+ passes, good but ultimately lose it in the middle 3rd
Good good moment for Ariana. She showed a lot better patients and decision making on the ball
Kendall showed good patients on the ball
Grace shows good vision with a one touch pass that into the final third for solar to run onto and get a shot on go
Just poor movement by midfield
Ari goes to shield for Sonia,  she gives a little shoulder challenge to the attacker who pushes her in the back and Ari reacts with a push back, I don't mind this, shows some fight.
Sonia is falling into a patter of punting the ball centrally, this isn't ideal as a short punt puts us in a bad spot. She needs to be targeting the wide channels.
Another punt right down the central channel straight to the opponent
Giselle doesn't challenge strong for the punt, defender wins it and passes to opponent
Back line did a nice job flexing off and delaying forcing a bad shot by the opponent
Cami correctly plays Kendall checking in.
Kendall misses the pass and turns it over.
Mack gives the attacker the inside channel; fullbacks too late to react on turnover.

Cami correctly comes out to defend the attacker on the ball, but bad angle of approach and comes in to fast. Needs to settle into defensive posture, delay her and keep her in front, not engage right away.
Cross comes in from G, Sophie does good to get a touch, we stay active in the box, Sola gets a good look at it but misses shot wide.
Cami does a nice job bringing the ball out on the dribble as the center back, finds Scarlett in the midfield, Scarlett plays a nice ball to giselle in the wide channel
Giselle rushes the cross and send it straight to the keeper,  I think she had time and space to go 1 v 1 and find another way in.

Ball is received around the 6 yard box, Grace takes to long to control/decide what to do, ball squirts out then as Scarlett is lining up to shoot the ball Sophie comes crashing in and defends her own teammate. It an effort play, but we have to be better here.
Scarlett is running even or slightly ahead of her midfield counterpart that's on the ball, but she isn't providing a good angle of support and isnt' playable, ultimately the ball is turned over.
Amy reads play in good possition intercepts the pass and secures the ball with a pass to midfield

Kendall, Scarlett end up in the same vertical channel with our 9 as well, ball squirts out to the central channel and nobody is there, we lose the ball. Sophie does well and comes down from the 9 spot to receive, she actually plays its centrally to the spot Scarlett just vacated. Scarlett needs to stay central in this scenario. But even after that the ball watching and lack of reaction by Ari wasn't great.

5+ pass string, from our D3 to the A3, worked the central and wide channel up the field for an early cross. Ally who normally doesn't practice with us, wasn't at the back post. But otherwise a solid play here by the team. Film Review
Sophie takes a heavy first touch that kills her time and space, then in a battle to regain the ball and we lose it. This was right at the top of the box and should've lead to a shot creation.

The ball is rolling back to our goal, Alexa is trying to shield and Sonia is caught waiting for the ball to enter the box to pick it up. Both Sonia and Alexa need to recognize the danger here and just clear the ball. Sonia really has the better read and view so it should be her just coming and clearing the ball away.
played through ball too early
Just completely hurried the situation, I can't tell if this was a cross or shot. Developing pattern, after a poor action, G has a habit of grabbing her boots or ankle.
quick 1 2 passing combo by these two then Amy forces a ball into the final 3rd but nobody was running.
Scarlett is receiving the thrown in, doesn't check her shoulder ball is intercepted, then her body language is poor and she doesn't react to the play, this sequence leads to a goal.

Good run to get open, but Giselle rushes  the shot as she enters the box and feels pressure. We have to have more composure on the ball, hold it up find runners coming in, even dribble a little more, but don't get rid of it so fast. Film Review
Scarlett does well to attack aggressively into the box, short cross to Grace who gets a foot on it but not with great quality.
can't tell if this was a shot or heavy first touch, but either way we have to have better ball control and quality in the box to create scoring chances.
I have 5 on players from the forwad line about 30 yards disconnected from our back line. Some are walking back, the only one making a real effort to get back is Sophie. Unacceptable. Film Review.
Great pass by Scarlett to find Giselle running in the wide channel. Leads to shot creation.

Giselle takes her first touch away from goal, this touch should go forward which will allow her to get a better strike and angle on the ball, but she is falling away from goal as she shoots and it goes straight to the keeper.  Film Review
Stabbed at the ball letting the midfielder to attack our back line. Film Review
Good job by Ally staying composed on the ball, taking one defender out and setting up her shot.

Poor positioning and effort by Kendall on the tackle, lets their forward to get into top of box and shoot, then poor save attempt by Sonia. Goes near post off the bounce but she shouldve collected this.
half hearted tackle attempt, not the best angle of approach
Good forward run, received and didn't force the issue
There just wasn't immediate options to play forward, more patience on the ball
Sola is dropping to low from the 10 spot
Carlee receives the ball on a back pass, heavy first touch then she quickly plays back to where the ball came from putting Alexa under pressure
Nice ball played up to Kendall in the wide channel, she takes a really heavy first touch that send the ball to a goal kick
Our 2 starts the play with her hands on her hips and is late to arrive to the fullback, our fullback isn't marked up to their winger. Film Review
Sola sends a long ball in the A3, but the defense has 7 players behind the ball, versus our 2. It has no chance. Film Review
Sola loses the ball, chases it down, Giselle is right there as well, makes no effort to join the chase, watches and walks back Film Review

Initial action to win the ball and dribble out was really good by Giselle, then there was two compounding actions, first the forced pass into pressure when we had a potential 3v2, then the lack of reaction to the turnover. Giselle was in the best position to initially shutdown the counter, the player who ended up with the ball and made the pass was left footed, which had Giselle pressured she likely doesn't get that pass off. Film Review

Film Review - Scarlet wins the ball and from the D3 plays a long ball. It's a tough run for any of our forwards to make a 40 yard sprint, beat three defenders and hope that help is on the way. We have to be more patient here.

Initial pressure by Sophie good, Amy in good position, then it kind of breaks down. Amy heavy touch takes what should be a scoring opportunity into defending, as the playing is facing her own goal only Amy is pressuring, Giselle is watching the BALL, instead of either engaging to shut the passing lane down or marking up the next player to receive. This last action is how they get out. Film Review.

Continuing from the last play, Amy does a great job of recovering, then defending, shows good technique separating the player from the ball before playing the ball, wins the ball then secures it with a pass to her back line. Film Review

n: Film Review - Couple things Carlee is in a good position to receive but in the ten seconds leading up to this play she is only watching the ball, same goes for Alexa and Ella. When the ball is played to Carlee she immediately switches the ball to Alexa who isn't in position yet and has a defending already running towards her. Ella isn't playable either as there is a defender between her and the ball. This is unavoidable if we're a little more calm and take in our surroundings. Stop ball watching. Film Review
after her turnover (carlee), chases back and clears the ball. Sonia also comes out of the back recognizing the bouncing ball which disrupts the play further to allow for the clearance.

Giselle does well to win the ball low in D3 to M3, beats the first player then takes space as she approaches the second player she tries to get by using the wide channel, but the defender does well to keep pace. At some point Giselle has to conceded and try and salvage her effort by putting her foot on the ball and finding a way back in or negative. She has Ella as an option had she done that.

Ellas positioning makes the pass dangerous as she is moving towards the defenders line to intercept instead of away, Carlee needs to play a better ball, the details matter down in in the defending 3rd.
Film Review, they just have to see it. I can't explain these couple of passing decisions.
Ella Sets the ball back to Carlee, but doesn't move into a supporting angle. Moves directly in behind the defender.

Film Review - Great job on the build out and good find by Mack to hit Sola dropping into the 10 window. Sophie 23 this is good moment for you to make a run across the width of the field instead of vertical to combine early with Sola.
